jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축인허가 대지위치 lane `building-permit-site-location` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_site_location already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, compare it, in the publisher's DuckDB, with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed site rows and a removal marker per vanished one (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two of the duckdb pool's runs go at a time, lanes or other in-process work: each holds one of its slots and a memory_claim on its unit (root ADR-0599, ADR-0605).
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-21, building-register-units. Under 16G: three runs, export 6m47s-7m00s CPU and about 10 minutes of wall time, `memory peak` 13.3-13.4G. Under the 8G this cap was for one day: one run, 61 minutes (17:37:58-18:39:25Z), 10m35s CPU, `memory peak` 7.2G - the export child held 6.68G resident and the cgroup sat at MemoryHigh with 18,933 `high` events and no OOM kill: throttled, not killed. journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 84 runs under 16G: highest 15,668M on 2026-10-20 (building-register-unit-areas). The other lanes measured on the DuckDB path the same day: 0.3G-7.1G.
jobs.memory_headroom_why: A measured working point, not 1.5 x a peak: the export sizes its workers to three quarters of what its cgroup has left, so its peak follows the cap, but about 7G of it does not shrink - at 8G nothing was left for it to work in. 16G is the cap under which the largest export is measured to finish in ten minutes. One number for all 54 lanes, because they share one unit template: it over-reserves for the small lanes (1-7G), and a request per lane comes with the Dagster resource tags that replace this admission (root ADR-0583 follow-up).

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 231 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed once, on its first load.

assets.title: 건축인허가 대지위치
assets.description: 허가나 동이 선 필지마다 한 행: 대표 대지 여부, 지번, 지목, 주·부속 동 구분. 허가 하나가 여러 필지에 걸친 것을 말한다(기본개요는 대표 지번 하나뿐이다). 관리허가대장관리번호·관리동별개요관리번호로 기본개요·동별개요에 붙는다. 원문 20칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0464).

dependencies.description: 건축인허가 대지위치(mart_kcy_16) 20칸을 관리대지위치관리번호 마다 바뀐 대지 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145) from 시군구 column 5 and 법정동 column 9, not the 행정동 column 8; HUB 대지구분 empty or 2 (블록) composes none (FP-ADR-0023); a permit's site often names a parcel since merged or split, which the consumer carries to the current pnu through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
